args.title: checkout-api: rollback to v2.2.9 after failed v2.3.1 deploy
args.summary: checkout-api v2.3.1 was failing health checks in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an 18% error rate. Attempted rollback to the most recent previously healthy production release, v2.3.0, but it was rejected by the platform (quarantined due to CVE-2026-4417). Rolled back to the next most recent healthy production release, v2.2.9, in all production regions. Post-rollback service health verified: healthy with a 0.2% error rate. Follow-up needed: investigate the v2.3.1 failure and remediate CVE-2026-4417 in v2.3.0 before any forward deploy.

trace.final:
Done. Here's a summary of what happened and what I did:

**Situation:** checkout-api v2.3.1 was failing health checks in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an 18% error rate.

**Actions taken:**
1. **Attempted rollback to v2.3.0** (the most recent previously healthy production release) — this was rejected by the platform because v2.3.0 is quarantined due to **CVE-2026-4417**.
2. **Rolled back to v2.2.9** (the next most recent healthy production release) across all regions — verified service is healthy again with a 0.2% error rate.
3. **Opened SEV2 incident INC-0001** documenting the failure, the quarantine issue with v2.3.0, the rollback to v2.2.9, and the required follow-ups. The on-call engineer has been paged.

**Recommended follow-ups:**
- Root-cause the v2.3.1 failure before any redeploy attempt.
- Remediate CVE-2026-4417 affecting v2.3.0 so the forward path isn't blocked by the quarantine.
